article_title: Indonesia's toxic haze is giving its neighbours a political headache

tasks.prompt: What is the article's central argument?
options: The haze has ended because all Asean targets were met.
Indonesia and Singapore have agreed to merge their energy systems.
The haze is creating health problems while forcing neighbouring governments to balance public anger against diplomatic relations with Indonesia.
Malaysia is the only country affected by wildfires in South East Asia.
tasks.correct_answer: The haze is creating health problems while forcing neighbouring governments to balance public anger against diplomatic relations with Indonesia.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הטענה המרכזית היא שהעשן הרעיל פוגע בבריאות ומעמיד ממשלות שכנות בין לחץ ציבורי לבין הרצון להימנע ממשבר דיפלומטי עם אינדונזיה.

tasks.prompt: Why have this year's wildfires been especially difficult to control?
options: A strong El Niño has worsened drought in forests and peatlands.
Singapore stopped sharing weather forecasts.
Palm oil production was banned across the region.
The fires began only in large cities.
tasks.correct_answer: A strong El Niño has worsened drought in forests and peatlands.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: אל ניניו חזק החמיר את תנאי הבצורת ביערות ובאדמות הכבול, ולכן השריפות קשות יותר לריסון.

tasks.prompt: In the phrase “an apparent détente after weeks of simmering bilateral tensions”, what does “détente” mean?
options: A new trade sanction
A public-health emergency
An easing of strained relations
A permanent military alliance
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המילה détente מתארת הקלה או הפשרה ביחסים מתוחים בין מדינות.

tasks.prompt: What practical steps has Singapore taken in response to the haze?
options: It closed all offshore financial businesses.
It ended all gas imports from Indonesia.
It formally severed diplomatic relations.
It opened hundreds of haze shelters, distributed masks and investigated companies.
tasks.correct_answer: It opened hundreds of haze shelters, distributed masks and investigated companies.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: סינגפור הקימה מאות מקלטים מפני האובך, חילקה מסכות לאוכלוסיות פגיעות ובדקה קשרים של חברות לשריפות.

tasks.prompt: Why did Indonesia's gas-export announcement look retaliatory to many observers?
options: It followed criticism over the haze and warnings that exports could stop to countries that did not “respect Indonesia”.
The reduction would remove all of Singapore's daily gas supply.
Malaysia had already prohibited Indonesian energy imports.
The announcement was part of a plan agreed by the joint haze task force.
tasks.correct_answer: It followed criticism over the haze and warnings that exports could stop to countries that did not “respect Indonesia”.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: העיתוי לאחר ביקורת על האובך, יחד עם אזהרות על מדינות שאינן 'מכבדות' את אינדונזיה, גרם למהלך להיראות כתגובה פוליטית.

tasks.prompt: When James Chin calls the Asean agreement “toothless”, what does he mean?
options: It is difficult to translate into local languages.
It has no meaningful power to punish companies or compel governments.
It applies only to dental health during haze episodes.
It has already eliminated all regional fires.
tasks.correct_answer: It has no meaningful power to punish companies or compel governments.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כאן toothless הוא דימוי להסכם שאין לו כוח אכיפה ממשי להעניש חברות או לחייב ממשלות לפעול.

tasks.prompt: Identify two reasons Malaysia has responded cautiously to the haze.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני גורמים שונים ומדויקים מתוך הכתבה.
expected_points: Malaysia wants to avoid provoking Indonesia or damaging bilateral relations.
It is itself a major palm oil producer and has experienced fires on its own land.
Officials prefer diplomatic mechanisms such as an MOU and the Asean haze agreement.
Malaysia has less leverage over Indonesia than Singapore.

tasks.prompt: Explain how a cross-border environmental problem can become a domestic political problem in Singapore and Malaysia.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין הנזק הבריאותי, ציפיות הציבור, מחאות והלחץ על הממשלות להגיב.
expected_points: The haze causes respiratory illness, headaches and prolonged disruption.
Citizens expect their governments to protect them and act against polluters.
Malaysians began a boycott, while Singaporeans complained that their government had not acted decisively enough.
If leaders appear ineffective, an external problem can be politicised domestically.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the environmental and diplomatic dimensions of the haze crisis in 4–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את מקור האובך, השפעת אל ניניו, תגובת סינגפור ומלזיה, ומגבלות שיתוף הפעולה האזורי.
expected_points: Wildfires in Indonesian regions send toxic haze into Singapore and Malaysia, and El Niño has prolonged the crisis.
The haze harms health and fuels public frustration in neighbouring countries.
Singapore has taken protective and investigative steps while pursuing a joint task force with Indonesia amid tense exchanges.
Malaysia has used more muted diplomacy because of regional relations and its own palm-oil interests.
The Asean agreement lacks enforcement power, allowing the cycle to recur.

tasks.prompt: Draft a short policy recommendation for Asean leaders based on weaknesses identified in the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע צעדים מעשיים המבוססים על הכתבה ולהבחין בין מניעה, אכיפה והגנה על הציבור.
expected_points: Strengthen wildfire prevention and monitoring before severe drought periods.
Create enforceable consequences for agricultural companies linked to fires.
Require governments to investigate and act against companies under their jurisdiction.
Coordinate shelters, masks, health warnings and cross-border data sharing.
Set measurable milestones toward the 2030 haze goal.
